about.title: Private Egypt Tours,
about.description: We're a Cairo-based tour operator. We run private day tours and custom multi-day trips covering the Giza Pyramids, Cairo, Luxor, Aswan, Nile cruises, and Abu Simbel. No shared buses, no rushed schedules. Just you, a knowledgeable local guide, and the places you actually want to see.
about.feature1: Private Tours, No Shared Group Buses
about.approachText: We built JES around the opposite of what frustrates travelers: fixed prices before you book, no surprises on the day, and guides who are there for you — not for a commission.

whyChooseUs.title: Why Travel with JES Egypt Tours?
whyChooseUs.subtitle: Egypt specialists based in Cairo, planning private tours for travelers who want to experience Egypt at their own pace.
whyChooseUs.card1Desc: Our tours are led by guides licensed by the Egyptian Ministry of Tourism. They explain Egypt's history, context, and stories clearly — without rushing you through the day to fit a group schedule.
whyChooseUs.card2Desc: Every tour is booked for you alone. Your guide focuses entirely on you, not on managing other travelers. That gives you more flexibility and more room to ask questions.
whyChooseUs.card3Title: Cairo-Based, Not Just an Online Booking Page
whyChooseUs.card3Desc: We plan your trip from Cairo, not from an office abroad. Direct communication, real local knowledge, and someone on the ground if anything needs adjusting.
whyChooseUs.card4Title: A Flexible Day, Built Around You
whyChooseUs.card4Desc: Want to spend longer at the Valley of the Kings? Skip a stop that doesn't interest you? We build the day around what you actually want to see and adjust when plans change.
whyChooseUs.card5Title: Pay by Card or Bank Transfer
whyChooseUs.card5Desc: We accept credit and debit cards as well as international bank transfers. Payment details are confirmed in writing before you book, so everything is clear from the start.
whyChooseUs.card6Desc: Send us your dates and what you want to see. We'll get back to you with a clear plan and a confirmed price — before you commit to anything.

tailorOffer.desc: Plan a private Egypt tour with a licensed Cairo-based team. We take care of the guide, route, and timing — you decide what to see and when.
